_about: USAF T.O. 1C-131B-2-2, page 2B: the Convair C-131B Samaritan (a Convair 340 airframe) three-view, a Wikimedia Commons scan (File:Convair C-131B Samaritan 3-view line drawing.png, 1850 x 2408 px, public domain). The side view: layers.py --mode image --threshold 170 at scale 3 (3 raster px per scan px), clip 280,90,1510,570 (scan px). Pixels of that raster, line centres. The crown runs along the 9 ft 5 in dimension's extension line from behind the windshield back to the fin (snapped onto it: one line). The ADF bump on the crown and the wing's root fairing and nacelle under the belly are bridged (hidden). The C-131B's R-2800 nacelle isn't traced: the Convair 580's Allison nacelle, measured on a photo, replaces it (derive.py), so its outline here is two free points a side. The fin is the 340's: derive.py replaces it with the 580's enlarged fin.
